exposure: previous caesarean section (CS) before the index caesarean delivery
cohort: Women with a history of a CS and a subsequent delivery
finding: Smoking in the first trimester, higher parity, and previous caesarean section before the index caesarean delivery were independently associated with an increased risk of CSP.
mod_finding: An elective CS at the index pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of CSP but did not remain significant in the multivariable analysis.
